title: Exemption.
bodyText: A facility owned or used by a government agency or by a nonprofit agency which is registered with the department of commerce and consumer affairs and providing services by contract for a government agency, shall be exempt from this chapter.
bodyHtml: [§445-90.5]  Exemption.  A facility owned or used by a government agency or by a nonprofit agency which is registered with the department of commerce and consumer affairs and providing services by contract for a government agency, shall be exempt from this chapter. [L 1987, c 333, §2]
